body.label: Target
body.html: Up to two enemies within ranged Weapon Range and 2 units of each other.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, each target is Distracted until the start of your next turn; choose one hit target to take 1 weapon Damage.

surges.html: Each hit target is also Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.
The next Damage dealt by one hit target's ranged Action before your next turn is reduced by 1.

rider.title: Lock - Suppression
rider.html: Choose one hit target. If it is Locked, you may end Lock when it next declares a ranged Action before your next turn to impose -1 on that Action's Success Die.
